events.name: The Venetian Resort Gondolas
events.description:
Please read this section for important information including how to book a private gondola.
In a city like Las Vegas where everything is must-do, The Venetian Resort gondola rides can’t be missed. Float down the Grand Canal underneath bridges and past cafes while a singing gondolier pilots your journey.
Tour the indoor route of the Grand Canal across shimmering water, past the Shoppes. Always great for couples, our gondola rides are a favorite activity among families and an extra fun thing to do in Vegas with kids.  
Same day reservations are NOT available online. Visit Emporio d' Gondola or the outdoor gondola ticketing booth.  

All sales are FINAL.  Please carefully confirm correct date, time, and quantity before completing purchase.  

IT IS STRONGLY ADVISED TO AVOID BOOKING ON DAY OF TRAVEL.  MISSED RESERVATION TIMES DUE TO TRAVEL DELAYS ARE NOT ELIGIBLE FOR REFUND, CREDIT, OR RESCHEDULING. 

Indoor Gondola Rides
Emporio D' Gondola Level 2, Grand Canal Shoppes


Last Gondola leaves the dock 15 minutes prior to closing.
Pricing and hours subject to change without notice.

All tickets are general admission, and guests may be paired with others.  To assure a private boat, please purchase all four tickets for your desired time slot.  Purchase all tickets for the same boat number (unless purchasing for a group of 5 or more). Do not combine tickets from multiple boats.  Your party WILL be separated.

All passengers over 2 years old require tickets.  Children up to 24 months are free but count toward total number of passengers.  4 MAXIMUM. No exceptions. 

For information on our gondola wedding packages, please contact Venetian Weddings. 
Email: Weddings@VenetianLasVegas.com

events.info: It's Saturday Night Fever every night with The Australian Bee Gees show. A Tribute to the Bee Gees. One of the most successful and adored acts in musical history is recreated on the Las Vegas stage in a 70-minute multi-media concert event. With over 22 years experience, "Jive Talkin'" you will be danced, sang and swept away with hits like "Staying Alive", "You Should Be Dancing", and "How Deep Is Your Love".
events.pleaseNote: Children under the age of 5 years are not permitted into the theater. Guests under the age of 18 years must be accompanied by an adult.

events.name: Tournament of Kings
events.info: Travel back to the times of challenge and chivalry! Don't miss the most popular Las Vegas dinner show, Tournament of Kings. Invading armies! Dancing maidens! Jousting! Fireworks! And eating with your fingers! It's the "one show on the Las Vegas Strip guaranteed to satisfy your appetite for adventure," according to What's On magazine.
events.pleaseNote: This show features horses, pyrotechnics, strobe lights, smoke and fog effects in an enclosed area. Guests are seated in close proximity to the horses and dirt arena. Therefore, persons sensitive to horses, dust or with allergies, asthma or respiratory conditions should attend at their own risk. No smoking is allowed in the arena. No photos or filming is permitted of any kind. Children three years old or younger may attend free of charge providing the child sits on an adult's lap and shares the meal. On occasion, previously scheduled and promoted performances of this show may be cancelled. Tickets are non-refundable and non-exchangeable. If you are hearing impaired and require an interpreter, please call the box office directly at 1-800-933-1334. 72 hours notice is required. Seats are reserved. If picking up will call tickets you must bring a picture I.D. and this credit card to pick up tickets. Tickets will not be released unless credit card, I.D. and reservation name match.

events.name: Colors of Mexico
events.description:
Step into one of the most unique cultural experiences in Las Vegas

Colors of Mexico brings together 7 immersive rooms, a restaurant - bar, and an arts and crafts store. All in one destination that celebrates the art, traditions, flavors, and spirit of Mexico.

More than an immersive attraction, Colors of Mexico's 20,000 sq ft invites you to explore, eat, drink, and discover all in one visit. Walk through breathtaking interactive spaces inspired by Mexican culture, enjoy authentic Mexican cuisine and handcrafted drinks, and handmade Mexican arts and crafts works that reflect the creativity and cultural richness of Mexico that you can take to home with you.

Whether you are visiting with family, friends, your partner, solo, or as a group, Colors of Mexico offers a memorable way to experience something different in Las Vegas.

The perfect experience for couples, families and groups, looking to discover Mexico in a memorable and meaningful way.
🎟️ YOUR TICKET INCLUDES
✔ Full access to the immersive experience
✔ $15 credit to enjoy at our restaurant, bar, or the art store.

events.name: Rich Little at Laugh Factory Comedy Club
events.info: The World-Famous Hollywood Laugh Factory brings its iconic brand of comedy nightly to Horseshoe Las Vegas. Founded in 1979, the Laugh Factory has been recognized as the "#1 comedy club in the country" by USA Today and is known for launching some of the biggest names in stand-up, including Tim Allen, Tiffany Haddish, Dane Cook, Matt Rife, Adam Ray, Drew Carey, Sarah Silverman, Bobby Lee, Brad Williams, and more. Legendary performers such as George Carlin, Jim Carrey, Dave Chappelle, Rodney Dangerfield, Jay Leno, Eddie Murphy, Richard Pryor, Chris Rock, Jerry Seinfeld, and Robin Williams have also graced its stage. With locations in Hollywood, Long Beach, Covina, San Diego, Chicago, Reno - and now Horseshoe Las Vegas - the Laugh Factory features 3 new comedians every week and 2 shows nightly at 8:30pm & 10:30pm. Visit LaughFactory.com.
events.pleaseNote: This is a general admission venue. Seating within each section is assigned upon arrival. GROUPS Orders of 20 or more should be referred to the Group Sales department at entgroupsales@caesars.com The venue reserves the right to implement security procedures designed to protect the experience for our customers.

events.name: Awakening
events.info: Awakening at Wynn Las Vegas takes audiences on an immersive adventure, with a dynamic fusion of mind-bending illusions, captivating choreography, breathtaking puppetry, stunning acrobatics, and cutting-edge technology. The story follows IO, a reluctant heroine who travels through the realms of water, air, and earth to reunite Light and Darkness and restore balance to her world. The 80-minute production delivers a multisensory experience inside one of the world's most advanced 360-degree theaters, featuring a state-of-the-art glass stage enhanced by custom LED screens and visuals. Named "Best Production Show" by the Southern Nevada Hotel Concierge Association, Awakening Showcases 60 performers from around the world and is narrated by award winning actor Anthony Hopkins. The show is masterminded by creative visionaries Baz Halpin, Bernie Yuman, and Michael Curry.
events.pleaseNote: Doors for Awakening open 45 minutes before the 4:00 pm & 6:30 p.m. show and 30 minutes before the 7:00 pm & 9:00 p.m. show. Awakening runs 80 minutes with effects, including pyrotechnics, lighting, smoke, and sound. These elements may be disruptive to guests with certain conditions. Audience members may capture content on mobile devices, but no cameras or recording is permitted. Self-parking garages close to the theater are available at Wynn and Encore. Awakening is intended for ages 5 years or older; an adult must accompany children.
